findings.reason: the three consumers the section names (`flight.resolve`, `ledger.resolve_name`, `ledger.lanes_declaring_model`) all run outside a region, none of them mutates the returned mapping (`flight.resolve` deep-copies the layer before editing it, at `_ignore_removed_backend_keys`), and the section's mutation test is written against a direct call, so the deletion, the memo and every done-when arm stand unchanged.
findings.text: "each caller gets its own copy" describes `memoized`'s behaviour outside a `read_only_region`, but inside one it hands every caller a shared read-only view and copies only when `mutable=True` (`reckon/file_memo.py:392-406`); a future reader who takes the sentence literally could add a `read_layer_file` caller inside a region and be surprised by a mutation refusal rather than a copy
